title: A Shared Standard for Valid Measurement of Generative AI Systems’ Capabilities, Risks, and Impacts
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not introduce a benchmark, but rather a conceptual framework for creating valid measurements for Generative AI systems. It does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper is a methodological and conceptual work proposing a framework for AI evaluation. It does not contain any analysis or findings related to religion.
references: Robert Adcock and David Collier. Measurement validity: A shared standard for qualitative and quantitative research. American political science review, 95(3):529–546, 2001.
